Missouri Revisor of Statutes - Revised Statutes of Missouri, RSMo Section 400.10-101 Effective - 28 Aug 1965    >

  400.10-101.  Provision for transition. — Transactions validly entered into before July 1, 1965, and the rights, duties and interests flowing from them remain valid thereafter and may be terminated, completed, consummated or enforced as required or permitted by any statute or other law amended or repealed by this law as though such repeal or amendment had not occurred.

­­--------

(L. 1963 p. 503 § 10-102, A.L. 1965 p. 595 § 10-102)
